title: France agrees to provide 16 Rafale jets to Ukraine, deliveries from 2028-2029
summary:

title: LayerZero to axe 14 low-activity chains after KelpDAO exploit – Details
summary: Chainlink has been the biggest winner of LayerZero's woes.
content: Following a recent exploit involving KelpDAO, cross-chain protocol LayerZero has announced plans to remove support for 14 low-activity blockchain networks. In the wake of these developments, Chainlink has emerged as a notable beneficiary, positioning itself as the biggest winner amid LayerZero's current operational challenges.

title: Coldcard now requires 65 key presses after seed exploit, while exposed funds still must move
summary:
Firmware 5.6.1 and 1.5.1Q harden new wallet creation but cannot repair a seed made on an affected release.
The post Coldcard now requires 65 key presses after seed exploit, while exposed funds still must move appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Coldcard has released firmware versions 5.6.1 and 1.5.1Q to harden new wallet creation following a seed exploit. The updated process now requires 65 key presses to improve security. However, the firmware updates cannot repair seed phrases already generated on an affected release, meaning users with exposed funds must still move their assets to a secure location.
